thread:
Maria: quick follow-up from the pinning sync 30 - I'm proposing a 'soft-unbind' transition mode for pins so we don't cause immediate cache churn when we flip model variants.
Evan: can you outline the runtime guarantees you need? e.g., do pinned clients still always see old variant during the window?
Maria: yes: pinned clients keep deterministic affinity. New resolver clients (opted-in) will follow ramp_strategy sampling. goal: smooth cache warmup and easy rollback if perf regresses.
Sofia: how is this materially different from a TTL + rollout sampling today?
Maria: TTL forces everyone off at expiry. soft-unbind leaves the pin in place but adds a "soft_unbind_until" marker and a ramp strategy. existing resolvers that don't understand soft_unbind behave exactly the same as today.
Ben: telemetry wise we need these metrics by variant+tenant: error_rate, p95_latency, cache_hit_ratio. add a boolean field to the metadata so dashboards can auto-populate.
Kai: for ramping i prefer deterministic hash buckets + percent overrides per-namespace. example: "hash:namespace:0-9->new,10-99->old" or a % string. keep it tiny and parseable.
Evan: shared GPU pools complicate things. what if new variant isn't available on some nodes? runtime should have explicit fallback_order in the pin metadata.
Sofia: propose fallback_order array: ["pinned","namespace_preferred","compatible_fallback","global_fallback"]. runtime must attach the chosen fallback reason to traces.
Maria: agree. also add a lightweight probe contract so clients (and smoke tests) can query pin state: probe=true -> returns variant_id, route_reason, health, and an approximate latency estimate.
Ben: can we show a tiny example metadata blob (as part of the thread) we can put into the migration PR? keep it simple.

```
soft_unbind_until: "1745325580"     # unix ts string
ramp_strategy: "hash_percent:namespace:5->25->100"
fallback_order: ["pinned","namespace_preferred","compatible_fallback","global_fallback"]
enforce_soft_unbind: "false"
canary_namespaces: ["payments","search-team"]
probe_endpoint: "/v1/pin_probe"
```

Kai: note: parsing must be simple; no embedded scripts or regex rules. we should support either a compact string that the controller interprets or a small enum-driven structure.
Evan: what about backward compatibility? if a resolver ignores soft_unbind, it should still route to the pinned variant. we need an "opt_in_resolvers" flag in metadata.
Sofia: add that and default enforce_soft_unbind=false so safe opt-in.
Maria: ops playbook: migration flow is: (1) create candidate pin record with soft_unbind_until=now+X, ramp_strategy set, canary_namespaces list; (2) monitor telemetry for X minutes; (3a) promote to full rollout by setting soft_unbind_until=now (meaning old pins start to be drained), or (3b) abort by setting ramp_strategy back to 0 and shorten soft_unbind_until.
Ben: automation: controller should be able to auto-revert per-namespace if error thresholds crossed. we'll need a small set of SLO checks and an automatic action mapping in metadata.
Maria: add an examples section to the docs with a few real tenant rollouts and expected telemetry signals.
DeployBot: deploybot: model-routing-controller v2.13 deployed to staging at 1745323000 :rocket:
Kai: storage migration: existing pins lack these fields. migration script must populate enforce_soft_unbind="false", soft_unbind_until=null, ramp_strategy="". avoid touching pins without an explicit migration marker.
Evan: client docs update needed: resolver behavior, probe contract, and the new fallback reasons in traces.
Sofia: i'll write the fallback_reason spec and update the trace schema. i'll also add recommended dashboard queries.
Ben: i'll propose the telemetry dashboards and alert thresholds (error_rate>1% or p95 regression >20% triggers rollback).
Maria: action items: Maria -> PR with migration + sample configs; Ben -> dashboards + alerts; Kai -> parsing lib and controller changes; Evan -> client resolver doc; Sofia -> fallback spec + trace updates.
Evan: timeline?
Maria: aim for staging prototype by EOW, prod rollout next week assuming no regressions. :thumbsup:
Ben: ack. if alerts fire controller auto-rollback for canary namespaces.
Sofia: linking working doc once ready: https://go/rl-soft-unbind-wip (WIP)
Maria: thanks all, i'll post the migration PR and the sample config in the thread when ready.
